name: blockchains.github.io
summary: Blockchain Lab Hub: static GitHub Pages site with 75 free services (AI briefs via Grok, gas/RPC/chain monitors, finders, feeds), machine-readable services.json, health data, and the org-wide llms.txt and blocks.json catalogue.

entrypoints.name: services.json
entrypoints.usage: catalogue of every service with id, name, url, category

entrypoints.name: blocks.json
entrypoints.usage: aggregated blocks.json of every live Blockchains repo

entrypoints.name: llms.txt
entrypoints.usage: org-wide doc map for LLMs (+ llms-full.txt)

entrypoints.name: data/*.json
entrypoints.usage: gas.json, liveness.json, rpc-latency.json, incidents.json, events.json, jobs.json, grants.json, depeg.json, status.json, ai/*.json

compatible_with.how: tools are linked from the hub

tests.command: python scripts/gen_site.py && git diff --exit-code -- '*.html' sitemap.xml robots.txt && python tests/validate.py && (python tests/serve.py 43117 & sleep 2; BASE=http://127.0.0.1:43117 python tests/e2e.py)
